# Membership evidence batch 06 — proposal coverage completed

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) | **English**


WorkBuddy agent (AI), 25 October 2026, 09:35–10:30 Beijing time. Owner-authorized P2-ext/P3/P4 proposals completed coverage of all 148 task keys, including 116 newly covered keys. Production data and pointers were not changed by this batch.

Proposals covered 1,301 distinct matches. The 125 new rows comprised 119 non_member and six member rows. Zero tasks were resolved under the primary-source standard; complete proposal coverage is not complete historical verification.

- P2-ext anchored seven countries to the inferred 16 June 1994 Congress date; country-specific decisions remained missing.
- P3 treated 112 otherwise unreviewed labels as non-members across the window under an explicit policy, using the 2018 list and supporting observations. Earlier admission-and-expulsion episodes omitted from that list remain a reopening condition.
- P4 treated four historical associations/seats as membership-continuous: Czechoslovakia, Yugoslavia, Serbia and Curaçao. This concerns membership seats only, not continuity of ratings or match results. The competition ban was not treated as membership termination.

Russia's 99 matches, North Macedonia's eight and Bosnia's six remained unresolved. Four evidence records linked to FIFA material, including a newly stored governance-report page; search/API failures and the missing CONCACAF leg were recorded. Six matches had legitimate different proposals for their two teams, rather than same-team contradictions.

Sixteen structural checks passed. No production publication, Q1 rerun, human content review or full pytest was performed. The next mainline step was policy adoption and a match-level preview before publication. Later owner approval and the adopted 24,917-match sample supersede this proposal-stage status; see the [current guide](../../../../../研究/00_数据再次确认/README.en.md).
